propositions: Two DC harness cells in test_reconcile_pass.py assert on 'OK:' output lines that the canonical sync route deliberately does not print after commit c87afedba8 re-pointed them at sync.
The OK: summary is gated on 'route not in {"preview", "sync"}' per documented contract in docs/exit-codes.md, so the assertions are stale test-side defects not emitter regressions.

The sync route emits BRIDGE_STATE: converged on stderr regardless of mutations applied, so a one-for-one substitution would silently weaken the idempotence cell and allow thrashing passes to go undetected.
The zero-write evidence available on sync is BRIDGE_STATE: converged plus both RECON differ totals equal zero plus zero RECON: batch_outcome lines.
Helper predicates move to a new dependency-free module _bridge_output.py enabling unit-testable parsing without live Jira or credentials.
Both live cells remain enabled and green after rewriting assertions to check canonical sync stderr signals.
